decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the core yogurt business, but it has not appeared on the website since 2019, which raises the delisting risk somewhat.
The Abendbrotkäse was a flagship of the cheese expansion, but its absence from the website in 2020-2021 suggests weaker support, so it is kept with moderate risk.
A basic semi-hard cheese wheel fits the organic cheese range and is a staple that is rarely withdrawn.
The multi-variant spicy cheese line is prone to trimming of variants, but the line as a whole is likely retained.
The mild creamy soft cheese has mainstream appeal but faces strong competition on retail shelves, so it carries moderate risk.
The niche washed-rind soft cheese has the highest risk of retailer delisting, yet it is still more likely than not to stay on the market.
